none: PAS NLM-F47C42: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Two Victories issue of 318-320, Reece period 16, Ticinum mint. Obverse description: Bust helmeted and cuirassed right, possibly double struck. Obverse inscription: [--]ANTINVS[--]AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding shield inscribed VOT/PR over altar or fluted column. Reverse inscription: [VICT]ORIAE LAETAE PRINC…
